lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What's all the fuss? I'm right here.
Ahead of us, Grave places the coffin amongst a pile of various mechanical devices.
We watch for a while, and Grave simply stares at the coffin without moving an inch.
She appears to, for some reason which remains unclear, be exhausted.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I'm not detecting any Raptures nearby.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: The likelihood of an encounter is quite low.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: We have the advantage. We should attack.
Let me try talking to her first.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't be a fool. We're dealing with a hostile force here.
I'm not so sure of that. And besides, she seems to be running on empty.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'll aim for her legs. After that, you...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: They appear to be homemade. The explosions aren't stable.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Damn! She does NOT want us to get close!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What are you even carrying around a gun for? Is that just for show?
Flames spew from the barrel of Grave's weapon.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: This is gonna be a direct hit!
The bullets fired by Grave explode in mid-air.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: On track for an indirect impact.
The bullets once again explode in mid-air.
Vesti files a missile, which lands in front of Grave and explodes.
Even as Grave staggers, she continues to aim her weapon at us.
Grave fires off a shot, which veers wildly into the air and explodes.
At the same time, Eunhwa gets into position and fires her weapon.
She attempts to raise her weapon at us, but doesn't appear to have the strength, and is unable to stand.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You took her down with one shot...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'm not exactly sure what you hope to accomplish, but go.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You've got a knack for talking to people, so I'll give you a chance.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'm warning you, though. The moment I detect you're in danger, I'm stepping in.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: But our orders are to take her by force or eliminate her...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'll take responsibility for what happens. Now go.
I don't want you to lose control and get us into another brawl unexpectedly.
I raise both my hands up and slowly approach Grave.
How many warnings are you going to give me?
Is that a Heretic you're carrying inside there?
Then what should I call it?
To be fair, I'd be more weirded out if she wasn't acting hostile towards me.
I have to proceed with extreme caution.
Grave swings her weapon within an inch of my face.
I can feel the air blowing across the tip of my nose as it passes by.
A dull, metallic clicking sound comes from Grave's hand.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Blowing yourself up isn't the answer, you fool.
A giant clamp-like object slams Grave to the ground.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hmm? What do we have here?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: What the... why is she reacting like this?
Another clamp detaches itself from the woman's back and shoots towards Rapi.
Rapi catches the clamp with her hand,
her feet digging into the ground from its tremendous strength.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Wow, you're able to block this?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: The Four Beasts shall descend upon the earth.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: They will tear up the ground, flood it with water, blot out the sky, and incinerate it with blue flame.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Have you ever heard this verse?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Of course you haven't, because I made it up!
Behemoth's clamp pushes Rapi to the ground and begins to crush her.
Rapi lies motionless underneath the clamp.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: We've got to kill this thing.
Behemoth raises one of her clamps and slams it down on the ground.
When the clamp comes back up,
it is carrying a chunk of crystal so enormous that I can't see either end of it.
Anis and Neon rush towards me,
Behemoth slams the crystal on the ground, sending shattering crystal fragments flying everywhere, along with heaps of dust which obscure my view.
It's as if a bomb went off.
Amongst the dirt and debris, I see Behemoth clamping onto Grave's coffin.
Behemoth is treating it like a prized treasure.
Another plume of dust comes rushing in, obscuring my vision.
I crouch down and shut my eyes,
trying to process everything that's unfolding before me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't act like you have a say in the matter after that embarrassing display.
Shifty, what can you tell us about Behemoth and Grave's movements?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Tracked a signal that's inching along. I suspect that's Grave.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: As for the one calling herself Behemoth... it's strange.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I'm not getting any readings from her at all.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Even when she was directly in front of you, I wasn't getting anything.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: And most likely the one who calls the shots here.
I saw Behemoth take the coffin.
Grave values that coffin more than anything, and would do anything to get it back.
If we follow Grave, she's sure to take us to Behemoth.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: That's a sound plan. Let's move.
